questions.prompt: Which summary best matches the article?
options: New panels are working at 21 public sites, and their income will pay for the Wallacetown project.
Public sites offer possible new projects, with advice available and an existing project showing potential benefits.
CARES is buying 21 sites, while local groups decide how to spend money already earned by schools.
Wallacetown schools need new sites, so Local Energy Scotland is choosing hospitals and courts for them.
questions.explanationZh: 全文先介绍21处潜在场址及可获得的支持，再用Wallacetown既有项目的预期收益作例子。其他概括把潜在项目说成已运行、把资金信息说成购地安排，或把两个不同项目的地点和用途混为一谈。

questions.prompt: Why might a community contact Local Energy Scotland?
options: To choose a school for the Wallacetown project.
To arrange how money from the three schools is spent.
To learn where the government is building new hospitals.
To get project advice and information about funding.
questions.explanationZh: 第7至8句列出项目建议、技术支持以及CARES资金信息；文中并未说该机构负责安排Wallacetown三所学校的收益用途、替该项目选校或建设新医院。

questions.prompt: What does the £1 million figure describe?
options: Money the three schools have already raised this year.
The amount CARES has paid for every possible new site.
Expected money for local investment over 25 years.
The cost of putting panels on the two named buildings.
questions.explanationZh: 100万英镑是Wallacetown项目25年内用于当地投资的预期收入，不是已收到的钱、所有地点的资助或两座建筑的安装成本。
